title: World Bloom — Ordinary, Yet Special Us — Episode5 The Ace's Decision

meta.Event Outline: Things have been going well for Leo/need since their professional debut. One day, a change in the tree in their SEKAI brings them to a dream world—one where they never became estranged.

rows.Line: After school
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy

rows.Speaker: Club Captain
rows.Line: Gather 'round!

rows.Speaker: Club Members
rows.Line: Okay!
se_run_women_003_4

rows.Speaker: Advisor
rows.Line:
Nice work again today.
I know you've all been working very hard these last few days, and I have a couple pieces of good news for you.

rows.Speaker: Advisor
rows.Line: First, the travel match that's been in the works has finally been made official.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: R-Really...?!

rows.Speaker: First-Year Club Members
rows.Line: That's awesome! I was convinced that they'd only want to play against another strong school!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It felt like something straight out of a manga, you know?!
se_event_wl_2nd_lightsound_2025_003

rows.Speaker: Advisor
rows.Line: Yes, this is a rare opportunity for our school. They've already retired, but we need to thank the third-years for the results they were able to achieve. The second-years who supported them must also be mentioned.

rows.Speaker: Advisor
rows.Line: Tenma, I believe your drive and passion played the biggest role since it got everyone else motivated.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, me?

rows.Speaker: Advisor
rows.Line: Yes. Not only did your determination never wane, you always practiced with optimism and that smile of yours.

rows.Speaker: Advisor
rows.Line: This club originally didn't take things all that seriously, but your motivation was just that infectious, Tenma.

rows.Speaker: Advisor
rows.Line: As a result, we all decided that we wanted to get better at this sport.

rows.Speaker: Advisor
rows.Line: The fact of the matter is that your hard work and dedication have helped change this club. So much so that we were able to achieve our first strong showing during that tournament in March.

rows.Speaker: Advisor
rows.Line: That's made it easier for us to organize scrimmages with other schools, including the trip we'll be taking soon.

rows.Speaker: Advisor
rows.Line: However, there's no guarantee that we'll get this chance again, so we need to make the absolute most of this opportunity.

rows.Speaker: Club Members
rows.Line: Right!

rows.Speaker: Club Captain
rows.Line: Let's do our best, Saki!

rows.Speaker: Second-Year Club Member
rows.Line: As this club's ace, you gotta show them just how amazing you are!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haha! You've gotta be amazing too, y'know!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (This club's ace...!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I wasn't expecting to be called that!)

rows.Speaker: Advisor
rows.Line: I'll provide details regarding the schedule for our trip at a later date. Now, on to our second piece of good news...

rows.Speaker: Advisor
rows.Line: Instead of the standard practice we originally had scheduled for Saturday, we'll be having Harugahara High School over for a practice match.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, that's the school we lost to during team regionals!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I remember how frustrated we all were because we'd lost so many close matches.)

rows.Speaker: Second-Year Club Member
rows.Line: This is our chance to finally beat them, Saki!!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Right! I know it's just a practice match, but we gotta win this time!

rows.Speaker: Club Members
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Advisor
rows.Line: While we're on the subject, now that we'll be playing a practice match, the time we have allotted to club activities will be extended. You'll all need to check that you don't have any conflicts that day.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (N-No, I forgot...! Saturday's when...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(What do I do...?
Ichi's really excited about us hanging out.)

rows.Speaker: First-Year Club Member
rows.Line: I know we planned on seeing that movie in the afternoon, but I guess it'll just have to wait until next week.

rows.Speaker: Second-Year Club Member
rows.Line: Yeah. Let's focus on beating Harugahara!

rows.Speaker: Club Captain
rows.Line: I also need to reschedule the plans I made with my friends.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(Yeah...
This is our chance to beat them.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I'm sorry, Ichi.)
Tenma Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm back...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, Saki, welcome home!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Tsukasa!
Didn't you say you had to practice for that show today?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: About that. It seems that I'll be playing the piano during it, so I decided to leave practice early and come home.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Really?! What's this show about?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It's a moving tale of friendship!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The piano allowed two girls to meet and become friends. But it also causes them to drift apart.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: However, ten years later, a piano causes them to reunite. They're able to resolve their misunderstanding and become friends once more.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Really...? Also, wait a second. Does this mean you're gonna be playing one of these girls, Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No, I'll be playing their piano teacher.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haha. That makes a lot more sense.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: By the way, Saki, did something happen at school...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh?! Wh-Why do you ask...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Your “I'm back” didn't sound very happy. I had a sneaking suspicion...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
So, what happened?
I'll be more than happy to listen.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Umm...
The thing is...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I see...
And you won't be able to hang out with Ichika now.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Have you already told her?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: *Nod*

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I'm really, really sorry!
Especially since I'm the one who invited you, and made you keep that day open!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: <No, that's okay. More importantly, the school you're going to be playing against is the one you lost to during that tournament a little while back, right...?>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: <If you all manage to win, then you'll have the confidence to beat them the next time you face off during a tournament!>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: <So, Saki, do your best.>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Right on the day we got our schedules to line up.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Cheer up, Saki.
Ichika told you to do your best, didn't she?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So, the best way to repay her kindness is to go out there and win!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, you're right...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright, I'm gonna become the MVP and tell her all about how great I did♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, that's the spirit!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Now, why don't I play a song for you! It's called “Guaranteed Decisive Victory”!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, that title! Did you just come up with it?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I did! Would you like to play with me, Saki? I'm sure you'll feel much better in no time.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Then, if you don't mind!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Well then, here we go!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Tsukasa, you're going way too fast!
Where am I supposed to jump in?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hah hah hah hah!
Just go with the flow and your gut, Saki!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What?! Don't come crying to me if we end up making a mess of it!
Saki's Room

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Phew...
We hadn't played four hands together in so long. That was really fun.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Actually, that was the first time I played the piano in forever...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh... Not since we still had our band together, huh?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Talk about a blast from the past...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Playing music with them was so much fun.
But Shiho would always scold us for not being in sync...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I tried my best, but I kept losing track of what part we were all on and stuff. In the end, I couldn't really figure it out.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Looking back, we were really bad.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I really had a lot of fun...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We were able to connect with each other more than normal. I realized that music gives us the power to do that...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (But not too long after that, I had to stay in the hospital to take tests and stuff. We couldn't hang out at all.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I was able to go home... But all my energy went towards getting through each day and building up my constitution.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I'm fit enough to be in a band now.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But they're all way too busy, and I have club stuff to worry about.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Not only that, I'm the ace.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I've gotta show Ichi and the others that I'm healthy, happy and...

You wanted to get back what you lost.
That seems perfectly normal.
You felt that all those things couldn't wait.
But you don't need to be in such a hurry to make up for that time. It's okay to take it easy.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I thought I heard someone's voice just now...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wait, I know...!
I should think of a way to apologize to Ichi for breaking my promise.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hmm... I don't have practice during lunch tomorrow, so I could buy her some food or dessert.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, she's not doing tomorrow's broadcast, is she?! I should check real quick!
